validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/ROUTE/LENGTH/DIAMETER/COST/STATUS all independently re-verified by reading the full article text of both of the sheet's own cited youm7.com sources (the sheet's automated existing_ref_checks had FALSE NEGATIVES on Status and Cost because they searched for a literal English word 'construction' and a bare digit string '750000000' inside Arabic prose -- I fetched and read both pages in full to confirm actual support). (1) youm7.com/story/2024/9/24/.../6718755 (PPC/EGPC FY2023/24 general-assembly report, published 2024-09-24) explicitly lists among the company's efficiency-raising projects: 'كازدواج خط 16" من المنيا حتى أسيوط بطول 140 كم للوفاء بالاحتياجات المستقبلية لمعمل تكرير أسيوط من البترول الخام من ميناء السخنة إلي التبين ومنها إلى أسيوط' ('doubling/twinning a 16-inch line from El Minya to Asyut, 140 km, to meet future crude-oil needs of the Asyut refinery via Sokhna->Tebbin->Asyut') -- this matches GEM's route (El Minya->Asyut), Length (140 km), Diameter (16 in), and Fuel (crude oil) exactly, and confirms PipelineType=transmission (it feeds a refinery via a multi-segment trunk, not a gathering/process line). (2) youm7.com/story/2021/12/19/.../5585415 (an earlier PPC general-assembly report, 2021-12-19) contains the near-identical line 'ازدواج خط المنيا-أسيوط بطول 140 كم باستثمارات 750 مليون جنيه ... جارى تنفيذه حاليا' ('doubling of the Minya-Asyut line, 140 km, at an investment of EGP 750 million ... currently under implementation') -- this exactly matches GEM's Cost (750,000,000 EGP) and confirms the 'construction'/under-implementation status explicitly (2024 article does not re-tag it 'تم التشغيل' [operational] the way it does for several other listed projects, so it appears to still be ongoing as of the 2024 report). CAVEAT (why 'confirmed (caveat)' not a clean pass): both citations are the same outlet (youm7) reporting the same company's (Petroleum Pipelines Company, a subsidiary of EGPC) own annual-assembly project descriptions, and the project description is repeated almost verbatim across the 2021 and 2024 reports -- i.e. this is one institutional origin (PPC/EGPC self-reporting), not two independently-arrived-at sources, so I am NOT crediting this as 'independent' tier=high despite the precise numeric agreement. I was unable to search for a third, genuinely independent source (petroleum.gov.eg, egyptoil-gas.com, Wikipedia, etc.) because this session's WebSearch budget was already exhausted (200/200) before reaching this row, and search-engine result pages (Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo) fetched directly are blocked/CAPTCHA'd or return irrelevant cached snippets -- so this should be treated as an open item for a fresh session to add a genuinely independent corroborator, not as evidence the pipeline is unsupported. Long-running-project note: if PPC's own report was still listing this as ongoing 3 years after first announcing it (2021->2024), it may still be in construction as of today (2026) or may have quietly completed without a public announcement; worth a status re-check in a later pass. DUPLICATE/CLASSIFICATION check against the 46-row roster: NOT a duplicate of P7342 ('El Minya-Asyut Oil PRODUCTS Pipeline', 115 km, operating) -- different length (140 vs 115), different commodity (crude vs refined products per the source text 'البترول الخام'), different status (construction vs operating); the 2021 article separately itemizes a 115 km Tebbin/products line already 'تم التشغيل' (operational) as a DISTINCT project from the 140 km Minya-Asyut crude doubling. Also distinct from P7325 (El-Tibeen-Asyut Oil Products, 75 km -- matches a different line item in the same 2021 article, 'إحلال وتجديد جزء من خط التبين/أسيوط ... بطول 75 كم') and P7326 (El Minya-El-Tibeen-Asyut Oil Products, 20 km -- matches yet another distinct line item, 'ازدواج خط بطول 20 كم لربط خط التبين/أسيوط بمستودع التعاون للبترول بالمنيا'). All four are corroborated as separate, co-located but physically distinct pipeline projects in the same PPC report, not double-counts of one line. Owner: GEM lists Owner1=Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) 100%, ref=egpc.com.eg 'About EGPC' page (verified live, but generic -- does not name this pipeline specifically). Both youm7 sources attribute this project to 'شركة أنابيب البترول' (Petroleum Pipelines Company, PPC), EGPC's transport subsidiary -- EGPC as parent-level 100% owner is a defensible reading (standard GEM convention for Egyptian state pipelines) but the operating entity of record per the sources is PPC; flagging as a minor attribution note only, not a concern, since this matches the dataset's normal EGPC-as-owner convention across the roster.

summary: P7316 confirmed (caveat): real, correctly classified (crude, transmission) El Minya-Asyut project, not a duplicate of P7342/P7325/P7326 -- route/140km/16in/750M EGP cost/construction status all directly re-verified in full-text against the sheet's own two youm7 citations (both same-outlet PPC self-reports, so tier=medium not high; WebSearch budget was exhausted before a third independent source could be sought).
